content.comment_body: Hello, I'm attempting to connect a [product_name] device to thingsboard.cloud using MQTT. Despite trying various configuration options, I am unable to establish a connection. Here is the configuration I'm working with: Cloud type: MQTT Broker URL: thingsboard.cloud (also tried mqtt.thingsboard.cloud and the specific IP) Port: 1883 Client ID: LOGOMQTT Username: ACCESTOKEN (provided by ThingsBoard) Password: EMPTY Authentication: TCP (also tried TLS without authentication) Publish topic: v1/devices/me/telemetry QoS: 0 The device has internet access and DNS is set to 8.8.8.8. Despite this, I receive the error 'DNS parsing error.' I'd appreciate hearing if anyone has successfully connected a [product_name] to ThingsBoard in any way.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is attempting to link a [product_name] device with ThingsBoard Cloud using MQTT, but consistently faces connection issues, particularly with DNS parsing errors, even though the device has internet connectivity. This suggests either a lack of clear documentation, missing guidance, or possible compatibility challenges regarding [product_name]'s integration with MQTT cloud services.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes that [product_name] will consistently connect to MQTT brokers like ThingsBoard Cloud, successfully transmit telemetry, and that any encountered errors will be clearly explained or referenced in documentation.
